subject: Consolidated multi-entity invoicing pilot and temporary cadence change (Cepheus Health)
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@cepheus.health>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>; procurement@cepheus.health
Date: Mon, 27 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request — consolidated invoicing pilot for multi-entity rollout

Hi Soojin,

We're ramping Cepheus' rollout across six legal entities next quarter and procurement has asked whether Redwood can issue a single consolidated invoice on a quarterly cadence instead of six separate monthly invoices. The ask is driven by our AP system limitations and a single PO requirement for the program.

High-level constraints:
- We need consolidated invoices starting Jan 1 (pilot) for Q1 only (trial window)
- Prefer Net-60 payment terms on the consolidated invoice due to internal approval cycles
- Key POs cannot be split; procurement will only release one PO per program

I've attached a short doc showing entity structure and PO rules (Cepheus_MultiEntity_Structure.pdf, Cepheus_PO_constraints.csv). Can Redwood support a temporary quarterly bill + Net-60 arrangement during this pilot? If so, please share required approvals and any mitigations (credit controls, escrow) we should expect.

Thanks,
Aisha Khan
Head of Commercial Ops — Cepheus Health
attachments: Cepheus_MultiEntity_Structure.pdf, Cepheus_PO_constraints.csv
From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@cepheus.health>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Dec 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request — consolidated invoicing pilot for multi-entity rollout

Aisha — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. We can support consolidated invoices in principle, but this is a deviation from our standard invoicing flow and needs deal-desk/finance approval.

Quick notes on mitigation we can offer up front:
- Conditional Net-60 for a 90-day pilot window (we would revert to standard monthly mapping after the trial)
- Require a single program-level PO + entity mapping file (we've attached an internal memo for finance: RDW_ConsolidatedInvoicing_Memo.pdf)
- Put a credit cap tied to monthly ARR with automatic suspend if >30 days past due beyond Net-60

I'm looping in Karthik from Deal Desk to outline the commercial ask and Laura in finance for approval. Karthik — can you propose approval contours (discount, credit guardrails, and required signoffs)?

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: RDW_ConsolidatedInvoicing_Memo.pdf
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request — consolidated invoicing pilot for multi-entity rollout

Team — summary and preliminary recommendation:

Summary: Cepheus requests a time-limited (Q1) consolidated quarterly invoice covering six legal entities and Net-60 payment terms. They will supply a single PO.

Commercial recommendation (deal desk):
- Approve a 90-day pilot (Q1) with consolidated quarterly invoicing and Net-60.
- Add a 1.5% early-pay incentive if paid within 30 days of invoice date (optional for them to use).
- No baseline discount to list price; instead offer operational concession (invoice cadence + Net-60 pilot).
- Finance must approve credit cap and require a program-level PO and entity reconciliation file on each invoice.

Risk controls for Finance:
- Credit cap equal to 1.25x expected monthly ARR; automated suspension after two missed Net-60 cycles.
- Require a signed mutual action plan that lists the entities and how funds route.

Laura — can you confirm whether Finance will accept Net-60 for the pilot under these guardrails and whether the early-pay incentive is acceptable from an accounting perspective? If you prefer, I can prepare a short exec memo for signoff.

-Karthik
Senior Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Jan 2027 15:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request — consolidated invoicing pilot for multi-entity rollout

Thanks for the crystal-clear framing. Finance position below:

Decision: APPROVE pilot subject to conditions.
Conditions we need implemented before the first consolidated invoice issues:
1) Signed program-level PO and entity mapping (invoice-level reconciliation).
2) Credit cap as proposed by Deal Desk (1.25x monthly ARR) and payment hold triggers automated in the billing system.
3) Trial limited to one quarter (Q1) with explicit revert clause to standard per-entity invoices unless both parties agree to extend.
4) Bookkeeping note: record each entity as separate revenue recognition entries even if invoiced consolidated. Our team will own the accounting treatment and needs the mapping file.

Note on Net-60: Finance accepts Net-60 for the pilot under these guardrails. No upfront discount from list pricing. Early-pay incentive (1.5%) is allowed but treated as a cash discount; procurement should acknowledge this.

Please prepare a short sign-off memo / DocuSign and a mutual action plan that Cepheus signs. Once I have the signed docs and the PO/mapping file, Finance will provisionally flag the customer and schedule the consolidated invoice.

-Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Finance, Redwood Inference
From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@cepheus.health>, Oliver Grant <ogrant@cepheus.health>, procurement@cepheus.health
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Jan 2027 09:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request — consolidated invoicing pilot for multi-entity rollout

Aisha / Oliver — good news: Finance has approved a 90-day consolidated quarterly invoicing pilot with Net-60 payment terms subject to the conditions below.

What we need from Cepheus to proceed:
- Signed program-level PO (single PO covering the program)
- Entity mapping file (CSV) that maps line items to legal entities on each invoice
- Signed mutual action plan (we'll send a short DocuSign)

Optional: if Cepheus wants to use an early-pay incentive, we can add a 1.5% discount for payments within 30 days; it will be treated as a cash discount.

Next steps: I'll send a one-pager + DocuSign request this afternoon and a sample mapping template. Once we have the signed PO, mapping file, and MAP, Finance will enable the pilot and issue the consolidated invoice for Q1.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

— Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: sample_mapping_template.csv, RDW_Signing_Memo.docx
